title: Winey Canadian Wheat Casserole Hash
description: A crumbly, diabetic-friendly Canadian dish featuring chocolate chips and dashi-extract, perfect for meal-prep. It's a rich, savory, and slightly sweet casserole.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cocoa powder, and sugar.
Add the butter and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Beat in the eggs until the mixture is well combined.
Stir in the chocolate chips and dashi extract.
Pour in the milk and mix until the batter is smooth.
Pour the batter into a greased 8-inch square baking dish.
Bake for 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Transfer the casserole to a hot stone plate.
To serve, cut into 9 equal squares.
